correction.reason: The prior workflow was still treating causal T1/T2 scaffolds as if local component repair were sufficient for the production N0 architecture. The owner correctly identified that this risks a v0.3->v0.4 repair chain before N0 architecture closure.

architectural_findings_requiring_closure: Current T2 relation count is parameter/config shaped rather than a dynamic runtime schema axis.
Current T2 relation-step count is fixed by learned slot count instead of a shared iterative decoder with runtime stopping.
Current T2 hard argmax bridge discards relation/operator plurality before execution.
Current role/operation/control heads remain opaque fixed class vocabularies.
Current operation is one mutually-exclusive ID even though production queries can compose traversal and arbitration modifiers.
Current control maps to fixed applicability centers instead of preserving calibrated continuous applicability.
Current T2 continuous operator state is not passed into the frozen T1 executor.
Current relation schema lacks domain/range/argument-type constraints needed to avoid type-blind grounding.
Current frozen T1 executor uses learned relation-ID embeddings, so a semantically dynamic T2 schema would still terminate at a fixed relation ontology.
Current T1 executor therefore cannot demonstrate zero-shot/new-schema relation execution without parameter migration.
The adaptive structural binder is not yet production-implemented, so operator/executor interfaces must be closed against T3 requirements before more GPU work.
next_action: Close the production QSRE operator+binder+executor interfaces against the full EIPM workload and proof obligations, then build one precommitted multi-stage causal workflow. No additional GPU run is allowed before that architecture is statically and behaviorally closed.
